note: The most checkable fulfilment claim in months. A magnitude 6.0 near Naples on 10 March 2026, the strongest there in 63 years, is a real dated event of public record, and the prior Italy claims are in this corpus. Whether they say Naples, and whether they describe a quake rather than a volcano, decides it. Top of the list for the evidence pass.

Worth having beside the assassination and protection material: the audience is offering armed security and he is considering it.
Self-sealing: an official finding of accident would confirm it rather than count against it.

Three dates are emboldened in one passage, 9/11, the Fourth of July and Easter, which widens the target rather than narrowing it.
One of the few claims in the corpus with a hard number against a published series. National average petrol prices are reported weekly, so this can be settled to the cent.
